rules.name: Practicum (7 units)
rules.notes: All theater and dance practice classes (such as those in acting, design, playwriting, directing, and dance practice) may count towards this requirement.

rules.name: Electives (8 units)
rules.notes: All courses in TAPS and DANCE qualify as electives.

rules.name: Theater and Dance Studies (4 units)
rules.notes: Note: Refer to Past Bulletins to review courses that fulfilled the requirements above that were offered in previous years.

rules.name: Dance Practice (7 units)
rules.notes: A minimum of seven units of dance practice in technique, choreography, and performance are required. At least three classes are chosen from a specific dance form (e.g., Contemporary, Modern, Jazz, Hip-Hop, Ballet, or Social), and the attainment of intermediate or advanced level. At least two classes in a style other than the student’s primary chosen dance form.

rules.name: Electives (8 units)
rules.notes: All courses in TAPS and DANCE qualify as electives.

transferPolicy: External credit is evaluated on a case-by-case basis by the Director of Undergraduate Studies.
reviewNotes: With no subplan you complete the Theater and Performance Studies concentration: TAPS 1, 4 units of theater and dance studies, TAPS 39, 7 practicum units and 8 elective units in TAPS or DANCE. The Dance Subplan replaces it with DANCE 11 or TAPS 1, theater and dance studies, 7 units of dance practice, TAPS 39 and electives. Either way the minor is 24 units, and the practicum or dance practice classes, which the Bulletin describes without a list, are moved in by hand.
